title: (PDF) Fisetin as a Senotherapeutic Agent: Biopharmaceutical Properties and Crosstalk between Cell Senescence and Neuroprotection
abstract:
Fisetin was noted as the most potent senolytic compound in vivo, reducing senescence markers in both progeroid and old mice.
When were senotherapeutic approaches like fisetin first identified in research?add · The therapeutic potential of senolytic compounds, including fisetin, began emerging significantly in studies around 2018, marking a new avenue for age-related disease management.
Fisetin was noted as the most potent senolytic compound in vivo, reducing senescence markers in both progeroid and old mice.
The average human daily intake of fisetin is approximately 0.4 mg, derived from various fruits and vegetables.
